description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for LookupTable entities, providing methods to query lookup tables by associated surveys and keys.

classes.name: LookupTableRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for performing database operations on LookupTable entities.

methods.name: findBySurvey
methods.description: Finds all LookupTable entities associated with a specific Survey.

methods.name: findByKey
methods.description: Finds all LookupTable entities with a specific key.
